dict.string: MindExtract uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your audio locally. Nothing is sent to Apple or any server.
MindExtract records your microphone to capture your voice in meetings. Audio is processed entirely on your Mac and never uploaded.
MindExtract reads your calendar to suggest the meeting you're in so you can record it with one tap. Your calendar data stays on your Mac.

MindExtract can turn a meeting's action items into reminders in your Reminders app. It only adds the items you choose and never reads your existing reminders.
